title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. The forecast for part:350020 increased by 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we have verified the forecast increase and appreciate the prospect of additional business.

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. In response, we are prepared to extend the contract term to 36 months and accept your requested 90-day payment terms. Consequently, we can offer a revised unit price of €432.94.

Our current Angebot provides a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €432.94 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for moving to 90-day payment terms and offering the 36-month option. We value a stable, healthy partnership with Selvbrunn.

Our bottom-up should-cost cost:350020 estimates your unit cost at 403.21 EUR, clearly below your 432.94 EUR.

We propose 427.50 EUR per unit for 4,580 pcs per year. We offer two options: a 24-month term, or a 36-month term that extends your secured volume to 13,740 pcs. The change is about 1.3%, within the 2% your account team can approve without the pricing committee.

Which of the two terms do you prefer? Could you also confirm your earliest possible lead time?

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your should-cost estimate and incorporated the verified data into our revised offer. Our revised Angebot includes a price of €431.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. We prefer the 36-month contract term, as it provides stability for the annual volume of 4580 units.

As to the should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will contact you shortly to confirm our earliest possible lead time. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Frame agreement part:350020 – 36-month proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for the revised offer and the delivery schedule. We share your preference for the 36-month term.

We propose 429.40 EUR per unit, 90 days net, 4,580 pcs per year for 36 months. That is 13,740 pcs of secured volume, with level monthly call-offs as in your schedule. The step from 431.95 EUR is about 0.6%, well within the 2% your account team can approve without the pricing committee.

If the price freeze truly prevents this, could you ask for an authorized pricing review? Could you also say which call-off flexibility or variant would let you reach this price, and confirm your earliest lead time?

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement part:350020 – 36-month proposal
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We must hold our offer at €431.95 for the 36-month term and 90-day payment, as the management freeze on price reductions until December 2027 is absolute. 

For your review, our offer details a price of €431.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

To confirm your inquiry regarding delivery, our earliest possible lead time remains 49 days. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Application Engineering:
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 15.94 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 11.23 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 7.02 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Frame agreement 4600070530 – cheaper material variant and final step
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for confirming the 49-day lead time and the 36-month term.

Your scorecard sc:70530@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 84.6% this quarter.

Your application engineering team mentioned a cheaper material option. Could you share that variant and the unit price it allows? We would gladly review it technically.

On that basis we propose 430.40 EUR per unit, 90 days net, 4,580 pcs per year for 36 months. That is 13,740 pcs in total, with level monthly call-offs as in your schedule. The step is about 0.4%, which your account team can approve without the pricing committee.

We would like to close the renewal promptly.

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
